candidates.value_first_content: First-time food truck operators: there is no single "food truck license." It is 5-plus separate permits from agencies that do not talk to each other — business license, health/vendor permit, handler certs, commissary agreement, fire inspection. Map every item with agency, fee, and renewal date BEFORE spending; typical totals land in the low thousands with 4-10 week timelines. Full method (free, no signup): https://galaxyaek7-del.github.io/openclaw-factory/customer_site/guide-food-truck-permit-stack.html — disclosure: that guide links my $59 permit navigator.

candidates.value_first_content: If you run subscriptions: regulators check three things — disclosure before billing info, proof of consent, and cancellation at least as easy as signup through the same medium. Walk your own signup-to-cancel path and count the steps; if quitting takes meaningfully more effort than joining, that gap is the finding.
